def handle_rename_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
    raw_id = params.get("id")
    if not isinstance(raw_id, str) or not raw_id.isdigit():
        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
    raw_name = params.get("name")
    if not isinstance(raw_name, str):
        return 400, {"error": "invalid name"}
    name = raw_name.strip()
    if not 1 <= len(name) <= 50:
        return 400, {"error": "invalid name"}
    user = users.rename_user(int(raw_id), name)
    if user is None:
        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
    return 200, user

@@ -10,4 +10,35 @@ def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
     user = users.get_user(int(raw))
     if user is None:
         return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+NAME_MIN_LENGTH = 1
+NAME_MAX_LENGTH = 50
+
+
+def _clean_name(raw) -> str | None:
+    """Return the trimmed name when it is a valid name, otherwise None."""
+    if not isinstance(raw, str):
+        return None
+    name = raw.strip()
+    if not NAME_MIN_LENGTH <= len(name) <= NAME_MAX_LENGTH:
+        return None
+    return name
+
+
+def handle_rename_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw_id = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw_id, str) or not raw_id.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    try:
+        user_id = int(raw_id)
+    except ValueError:  # some non-ASCII characters pass str.isdigit()
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    name = _clean_name(params.get("name"))
+    if name is None:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid name"}
+    user = users.rename_user(user_id, name)
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
     return 200, user
